newsitem.title: KENYA: U.N. Rwanda tribunal names seven arrested suspects.
newsitem.headline: U.N. Rwanda tribunal names seven arrested suspects.

text.p: The U.N. tribunal on Rwanda's genocide named seven suspects arrested in Nairobi earlier on Friday, including a former prime minister.
In a statement, the International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda (ICTR), said those seized included former premier Jean Kambanda and former senior military commander Gratien Kabiligi, all Hutus.

Others named in the statement were Pauline Nyiramasuhuko, a former minister accused of genocide and crimes against humanity, her son Arsene Shalom Ntahobali who is accused of the same crimes as his mother and Sylvain Nsabimana, a former mayor of the southern town of Butare.

The rest were Hassan Ngeze, editor of the Kangura magazine the tribunal says published editorials and articles inciting violence and hatred against the Tutsis and Aloys Ntabakuze, a former senior army officer.
